title: DroneRuntimePosture
description: External runtime posture object (v0.3 §24, T7). MUST originate from a source other than the agent being governed. Self-reported posture from the agent is not a valid instance of this schema for authorization purposes (see ATS-010).

source.description: The subsystem/service that issued this posture (e.g. navigation_integrity_service). Must be distinct from the agent under governance.

authority.description: The trust authority that vouches for this source.

signature.description: Cryptographic signature over the posture payload. Unsigned or expired posture must not be treated as trusted (see failure_behavior).

failure_behavior.description: What DROS does if this posture cannot be freshly verified (e.g. 'DENY_PRIVILEGED_ACTIONS', 'DOWNGRADE_TO_GPS_UNTRUSTED'). Must be explicit, not implied.
